title: Call to Action
description: A closing dark panel with one primary action, a softer alternative and three concrete promises about the trial.
summary: A dark-island CTA panel with actions and trial guarantees.
notes: The panel sets data-theme="dark", Actual CSS's documented theme island, so it stays dark on light and dark pages alike.
Both actions are placeholder fragment links. The trial terms are sample copy; state your real ones.
The checkmarks are decorative inline SVG; each promise is plain text.
